user.title: Connect to a photo frame
user.description: Enter the address of the tablet running the Photo Frame app.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the frame.
data_description.port: Port of the frame's local API (default 8765).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered photo frame
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} ({host})? A pairing code will be shown on the frame.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: A 6-digit code is now displayed on {name}. Enter it below within 2 minutes.

data.ha_access: Give the frame access to Home Assistant (for Assist and widgets)

data_description.code: The 6-digit code shown on the frame.
data_description.ha_access: Creates a dedicated non-admin "Photo Frame" user with a long-lived access token and sends it to the frame, so you don't have to type a token on the tablet.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair {name}
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts Home Assistant's token. Submit to show a new pairing code on the frame.

error.invalid_code: The pairing code is wrong or has expired.

abort.no_id: The discovered frame did not advertise an id.
abort.wrong_frame: The frame that answered is not the one being configured.

init.title: Frame widgets
init.description: Choose what the frame shows on top of the photos.

data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL for the frame (optional)
data.now_playing_entities: Now playing: other speakers to show

data_description.weather_entity: Weather entity used by the weather widget.
data_description.entities: Lights, switches, scenes and other entities shown as buttons on the frame.
data_description.ha_url: Only needed if the frame shows "Disconnected" from Home Assistant. Use an address the tablet can reach, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8123. Leave empty to auto-detect.
data_description.now_playing_entities: When one of these is playing (e.g. YT Music cast to a speaker, Music Assistant players), the frame shows the song with play/pause/skip. Music played on the frame itself is always shown.

error.cannot_connect: Could not send the settings to the frame.
error.not_loaded: The frame is not loaded. Make sure it is online and try again.
error.invalid_url: Must start with http:// or https://

cannot_connect.message: Could not communicate with the frame: {error}

no_target.message: Several frames are configured; select a frame (device, entity or config entry).

target_not_found.message: No loaded photo frame matches the selected target.

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Shows a message toast on the frame.

config_entry_id.name: Frame
config_entry_id.description: The frame to show the message on (alternative to a target).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to show the message, in seconds (default 10).

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Optional Material Design icon, e.g. mdi:bell.

show_asset.name: Show photo
show_asset.description: Jumps the slideshow to a specific Immich asset.

config_entry_id.name: [%key:component::photo_frame::services::show_message::fields::config_entry_id::name%]
config_entry_id.description: The frame to control (alternative to a target).

set_source.name: Set photo source
set_source.description: Changes where the slideshow takes photos from.

album_ids.name: Album IDs
album_ids.description: Immich album IDs (for the album source).

person_ids.name: Person IDs
person_ids.description: Immich person IDs (for the people source).
